| `content` | `union` |          | `\{\}`  | The configuration: `{ register, schema, scope?, route, own?, showCounts?, limit?, emptyText?, errorText? }`. `register` and `schema` (or `scope`, the index page's `savedViewsScope`) pick the views of one list page; `route` is the name of that index page's route; `own` (default true) keeps the signed-in user's views only; `showCounts` adds how many records each view matches; `limit` caps the list (default 10). `workspace` (`{ keys, count? }`) makes them the saved views of the dashboard page itself; see the component description. |
